item.description:
A smoother, more reliable VoxelWall

  • Browse wallpapers more smoothly with lighter, more efficient previews.
  • Improved live wallpaper startup and switching, including restarting playback after using Stop.
  • Better troubleshooting support to help us investigate playback issues more accurately.

More worlds. More music. Smoother control.

  • Explore 14 new wallpapers, bringing the collection to 51 animated worlds.
  • Feel the music in Liquid Filigree with richer red and blue patterns, brighter colors, and flowing motion that responds to your music.
  • Enjoy more even color and lighting in Origami Flight.
  • Keep controls responsive while audio connects, with more reliable starts, stops, and recordings.
  • Enjoy refreshed Energy Saver videos in both standard and ultrawide formats.

More reliable wallpaper recovery.

VoxelWall now recovers more clearly after sleep or a system update. Apply confirms the wallpaper is truly active before reporting success, and provides clearer setup guidance when macOS needs your attention.

Live 2: a stable wallpaper engine.

VoxelWall 1.0.38 moves live wallpaper rendering into VoxelWall Live 2. The stable extension stays installed while wallpapers, visuals, tuning, and 30/60 FPS preferences are delivered as changeable content.

Apply now waits for the exact requested scene to present from Live 2 before showing success. The app no longer treats its temporary preview as proof that the macOS desktop updated.

You can choose 30 FPS for lower rendering demand or 60 FPS for smoother motion. The Live 2 renderer applies the selected cadence.

Reliable wallpaper replacement.

VoxelWall 1.0.37 makes Apply finish reliably after an app or wallpaper update. It verifies that the newest wallpaper is actually visible, reloads VoxelWall Live when macOS is still holding an older wallpaper process, and avoids getting stuck on an endless starting message.

This update also improves compatibility between app versions and downloaded wallpapers.

More reliable wallpaper updates.

VoxelWall 1.0.36 improves Apply when a newly downloaded wallpaper replaces an older version, so the latest wallpaper starts cleanly and the setup status catches up without requiring an app restart.

This update also improves secure wallpaper download reliability.
